integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from Wick expansion, the determinant constraint for a correlation matrix, arithmetic-geometric mean, and explicit extremal Gram families. The bundled checker is only a supplemental stress test. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result treats the exponent-two product for a standardized three-dimensional Gaussian vector and optimizes only at fixed total squared pairwise correlation. It does not give the exact quantitative envelope for other exponents, higher dimensions, or a fully prescribed correlation pattern.
title: Sharp squared-correlation envelope for the three-dimensional Gaussian square product
